title: An Exact Algorithm for the Max-Min Covering Location Blocker Problem
summary: We introduce the Max-Min Covering Location Blocker Problem, a bilevel optimization problem in which a leader blocks a minimum-cost set of candidate locations so that the optimal coverage of a budget-constrained follower does not exceed a prescribed target. Each customer's coverage is determined by the least favorable open facility that can serve it. The induced follower coverage set function is nonmonotone and nonsubmodular, so the validity of interdiction cuts cannot be inherited from existing frameworks.
